title: Mixing and inequality: the gracias al sacar
goal: I can explain how mixing and inequality existed together and what the gracias al sacar allowed.
grammar: Subjunctive after value judgements: mixing and inequality

items: I can explain what the gracias al sacar was.
I can say that mixed-origin people were very numerous by the end of the 18th century.
I can say what it shows about how race worked in that society.
I can say whether mixing made inequality disappear.
I can use es importante que and es necesario que with the present subjunctive to give a judgement.
